verdict.rationale: Flutterwave is a payments SaaS platform, so an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence shows SDKs, REST APIs, a Postman collection and an llms.txt file, but nothing about an MCP server an agent could connect to. llms.txt and APIs are adjacent building blocks and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
